articles.summary: Highlights: Hess Midstream LP and Chevron have executed a definitive agreement that will establish Hess Midstream LP as an independent, multi-basin midstream company. The transaction includes the following: Hess Midstream LP will acquire Chevron’s crude oil and natural gas gathering and storage
articles.title: Hess Midstream LP Announces Transformative Transaction Leading to New Independent Multi-basin Midstream Company
